contract.purpose: Fleet Social keeps project-owned social drafts, review decisions, schedules, and per-destination publishing outcomes together.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md: Product Purpose; saas-maker/catalog/projects.json: fleet-social lifecycle.scopeDecision.keep
contract.canonicalPurpose: Fleet Social helps the Fleet owner review and publish posts for Fleet projects by binding each draft to its project, exact approval, and per-destination receipt.
contract.audience: Fleet owner managing social accounts for multiple Fleet products
contract.job: Select the originating project, review the saved post, and verify delivery for each destination.
contract.thesis: Keep project and approval controls beside the composer decision and delivery evidence in Posts.
contract.system: Preserve CogSend's centered canvas, floating navigation, white rounded cards, stone type, and semantic status colors.
contract.signature: Project attribution and approval state are visible together immediately above the post editor.
contract.risk: The added review card consumes vertical space on a phone; the composer and publish action remain reachable at 390 pixels.

projectCheck.command: npm test; npm run check; npm run lint; npm run build; Playwright 54-case local suite

findings: Local provider canary remains unverified; visual review used a seeded draft and no connected account.

ownerFeedback.note: Preserve the approved CogSend visual language for this bounded Fleet-specific addition.
